jobs.occupation: Städare för stor- och flyttstädning – Hemfrid Stockholm
jobs.description:
HEMFRID SÖKER DIG SOM VILL ARBETA SOM STOR- OCH FLYTTSTÄDARE
Hemfrid är Sveriges största företag inom hemstädning. Vi hjälper våra kunder med tjänster i hemmet så som städning, fönsterputs, flyttservice och mycket annat.
Vi söker ständigt efter personal som kan tänka sig jobba hos oss runt om i Stockholm och andra delar av Sverige. Besök gärna vår hemsida www.hemfrid.se/karriar för att se andra städer där vi söker personal i.

HEMSTÄDNING I VÄRLDSKLASS
Att jobba med oss på hemfrid innebär att du får ett roligt, varierande jobb inom städning. På vårt One-Time team arbetar vi i team där du alltid kommer att jobba tillsammans med flera härliga kollegor från hela världen.

Vi letar efter dig som:

Tycker om att jobba i team med andra kollegor

Ha tidigare erfarenhet inom städning

Är engagerad och vill utvecklas inom städning

Pratar svenska eller engelska

Kunna arbeta flexibla timmar

Det är starkt meriterande om du har körkort (B), och gärna egen bil

Det är starkt meriterande om du tidigare har arbetat som hemstädare, hushållerska eller motsvarande. 
Vi erbjuder dig;

Vi erbjuder dig allt från timanställning till en sysselsättningsgrad på 50–75%. Beroende på vad som passar dig!

Kollektivavtal och bra anställningsvillkor

Ansvarsförsäkring, sjukförsäkring, pensionsförsäkring och friskvårdsbidrag

Gratis mobilabonnemang

Utbildning inom hemstädning med fokus på din utveckling

Engångshemstädning

Härliga kollegor från hela världen

Är du nyfiken på var vi söker personal? Upptäck våra platser här!
Vill du bli en av oss? Välkommen med din ansökan!
Har du några frågor angående tjänsten eller vår rekryteringsprocess är du varmt välkommen att kontakta oss på hr@hemfrid.se.

HEMFRID IS LOOKING FOR YOU WHO WANT TO WORK AS A BIG- AND MOVING CLEANER
Hemfrid is Sweden's largest company in home cleaning. We assist our customers with household services such as cleaning, window washing, moving services, and much more.
We are constantly looking for staff who are interested in working with us in Stockholm and other parts of Sweden. Please visit our website www.hemfrid.se/karriar to see other cities where we are hiring.

WORLD-CLASS HOME CLEANING
Working at Hemfrid means you get a fun and varied job in cleaning, primarily for large households.

We are looking for someone who:

Enjoy working in a team with other colleagues.

Have previous experience from a cleaning profession.

Is committed and wants to develop within cleaning

Speaks Swedish or English

Can work flexible hours

It is highly desirable if you have a driving license (B) and preferably your own car

We offer you:

We offer everything from hourly employment to a workload of 50-75%, depending on what suits you best!

Collective agreement and good employment conditions

Liability insurance, health insurance, pension insurance, and wellness allowance

Training in home cleaning with a focus on your development

Free mobile subscription

One-time home cleaning

Wonderful colleagues from all over the world

Are you curious about where we're hiring? Discover all our locations here!
Do you want to join us? Welcome to apply!
If you have any questions regarding the position or our recruitment process, feel free to contact us at hr@hemfrid.se

Are you an experienced HIL Engineer who enjoys working close to hardware, software, and test automation? Do you thrive in a hands-on environment where you build, configure, and improve complex test systems used for advanced vehicle development? Then this could be your next opportunity.
ALTEN is now looking for a Senior Embedded HIL Engineer for an assignment towards one of our clients within the automotive industry. In this role, you will work with the development, maintenance, and adaptation of Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) environments, supporting multiple projects and contributing to the verification of next-generation vehicle systems.
About the role
As a Senior Embedded HIL Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining HIL test environments used for verification and validation of embedded systems. The role combines hands-on work with hardware integration, wiring, and troubleshooting together with software development, automation, and tool improvements.
You will work closely with developers, test engineers, and other stakeholders to ensure robust and scalable HIL solutions. The role also includes supporting test automation efforts, improving reusable tooling, and contributing to the development of efficient verification environments.
Main responsibilities
Design, build, and maintain HIL test rigs and hardware setups
Configure, develop, and maintain Vector CANoe environments
Perform wiring, pinout verification, and hardware integration activities
Troubleshoot hardware, software, and connectivity issues within HIL environments
Develop and maintain reusable tools and scripts for test environments
Support the automation of test cases and execution workflows
Collaborate with developers and test engineers to improve verification processes
Support and train users of HIL rigs and test environments
Contribute to the development of scalable solutions supporting multiple projects

Your profile
You are a proactive and solution-oriented engineer with a strong technical curiosity and a passion for embedded systems and test environments. You enjoy working across hardware and software domains and take ownership of technical challenges from start to finish.
We see that you have:
B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or equivalent
Several years of experience working with HIL development and embedded systems
Experience with Vector CANoe
Experience with Git and modern software development practices
Fluent in English, both written and spoken

Meritorious:
Experience with Git and modern software development practices
Experience with DDS and RTI Connext
Experience working in Linux development environments
Experience with C++ or Python
Experience with CARLA simulation environments

We warmly welcome your application already today!
About ALTEN
ALTEN is one of Europe’s largest technology and engineering consulting companies, with more than 57,000 employees in over 30 countries. In Sweden, we are a leading engineering consultancy within automotive, telecom, defense, energy, and industry.
At ALTEN, we believe in growing together with our employees. Through exciting assignments, technical development, and a strong company culture, we create opportunities for our engineers to develop both professionally and personally.
Welcome to read more about us at alten.se!
Please be aware that applications submitted via email or direct messaging will not be considered.
For any HR-related questions or request regarding a job application, please select the ‘Recruitment’ category in “Contact us”.

At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, more than 80 000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.
 
 
Could you be the full-time Project Verification and Validation Manager in Stockholm we’re looking for?
 
Your future role
Take on a new challenge and apply your technical expertise in a new cutting-edge field. You’ll report to the Engineering Group Manager, and work alongside driven teammates.
You'll be the technical interface between the solution and the project with the aim to provide fluidity in the implementation of the delivered systems.
 
We’ll look to you for:
Develop the project Verification Plan
Check the adequacy of the documented evidence from review, integration and testing with the specified verification objectives
Identify anomalies, evaluate these in risk (impact) terms, record and communicate these to the project change management body for evaluation and decision
Manage the verification process (review, integration and testing) and ensure independence of activities as required
Develop and maintain records on the verification activities
Develop the project Verification Report stating the outcome of the verification activities

 
 
All about you
We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
Degree or passion in engineering.
Experience or understanding of software requirements, data and code.
Knowledge of various verification approaches/methodologies.
Able to identify the most suitable method or combination of methods in a given context.
Familiarity with deriving the types of verification from given specifications.
Understanding of CENELEC standard EN 50128.
Analytical thinking ability and good observation skills.
Very good English skills. Swedish is an advantage.

 
 
Things you’ll enjoy:
Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:
Enjoy stability, challenges and a long-term career free from boring daily routines
Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues
Contribute to innovative projects
Utilise our agile working environment
Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning
Progress towards senior roles.
Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension).

 
 
 
 
You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!
 
Important to note
As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

jobs.employer_name: HOCHTIEF Infrastructure GmbH Tyskland Sverige     Filial
jobs.description:
Procurement Manager
OL31 Rail Project, Vagnhärad, Sweden

Shape the future of Swedish infrastructure
HOCHTIEF is one of the world's leading infrastructure and construction groups, employing approximately 38,000 people worldwide. We deliver complex projects across a wide range of sectors, including roads, bridges, tunnels, railways, airports, ports, buildings, and both conventional and renewable energy. With operations across Europe, North America, and the Asia-Pacific region, HOCHTIEF combines engineering expertise with innovative and sustainable solutions to shape the infrastructure of the future.
We are looking for a Procurement Manager to support the successful delivery of the OL31 Project in Vagnhärad.
The OL31 Project forms part of the Ostlänken programme, one of Sweden's largest and most important railway infrastructure investments. Ostlänken is a new approximately 160-kilometre double-track railway connecting Järna and Linköping, designed to increase capacity, improve regional connectivity and support sustainable transport across Sweden.
The project involves complex civil engineering works, extensive stakeholder coordination, demanding management of sophisticated procurement activities. Working on OL31 offers the opportunity to contribute to a landmark infrastructure programme that will have a lasting impact on Sweden's transport network and future development.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and implement project procurement strategies, procurement plans and procedures in compliance with company’s management system.
Lead the prequalification of subcontractors and suppliers.
Lead tendering, supplier selection and contract award processes.
Manage procurement schedules, budgets and supplier performance.
Ensure compliance with Swedish procurement regulations, industry standards and company procedures.
Establish and maintain strong relationships with suppliers and subcontractors.
Support commercial and project teams in contract negotiations.
Identify procurement risks and implement mitigation measures.
Drive continuous improvement of procurement processes and supply chain performance.

Your Profile
Requirements
Minimum 7 years of experience in a procurement management role within the infrastructure construction sector.
University degree in engineering, construction, or another relevant technical discipline.
Strong knowledge of Swedish procurement systems, supplier markets and procurement practices.
Experience managing high-value procurement packages and strategic sourcing activities.
Strong understanding of Swedish contractual and regulatory requirements, including proficiency in the AMA system.
Excellent negotiation, supplier relationship management, and stakeholder engagement skills.
Proven ability to work in complex, multi-stakeholder project environments.
Strong attention to detail.
Excellent organizational and planning skills, with a strong ability to meet deadlines.
Strong work ethic with a proactive and results-oriented approach.

Language Requirements
Fluent in English and Swedish.
We Offer
The opportunity to work on one of Sweden's largest and most complex infrastructure projects.
An international working environment within a leading global construction company.
Long-term project involvement with significant responsibility and influence.
The chance to contribute to the development of critical rail infrastructure in Sweden.

Location
Vagnhärad, Sweden
Apply
If you have the qualifications, experience, and passion for creating a safe and successful construction environment, we would love to hear from you.
Get in touch with Nicole Granlund nicole.granlund@hochtief.se,
or apply directly at: https://hochtief.se/karriar/ 
Join HOCHTIEF and help build the infrastructure of tomorrow.

Company description:
Ericsson AB
Job description:   Join our Team   About this opportunity:
 We are looking for a skilled, experienced, and self-motivated Operation Product Owner (OPO) for the Packet Core test environment. You will be part of a team that values collaboration, teamwork, and work-life balance and work closely with Test Environment Scrum Masters, architects, APOs, other OPOs, XFT, and other teams to ensure that our test environment and labs serve their intended purpose: enabling the development and testing organizations to test according to their needs.
 The role also focuses on managing the roadmap and prioritizing the test environment backlog. As the OPO you will ensure that the “why” behind each request is well understood and you communicate that vision clearly to engineering teams, maximizing product value. The role drives delivery by setting sprint and delivery goals, coordinating dependencies, removing blockers, and tracking performance against key objectives. The OPO works closely with APOs, other OPOs, development teams, and internal and external stakeholders to share progress and gather valuable feedback.
  
 What you will do:
 - Own, prioritize, and continuously improve the team backlog, with transparent visibility of all incoming requests.
 - Create a clear vision by managing the roadmap, with a focus on the "why" behind each request.
 - Set sprint and delivery goals, coordinate dependencies, remove roadblocks, and track progress against key objectives.
 - Ensure that the lab and test environment meet the requirements of the PDU, PC, and CP development organizations.
 - Act as a bridge between the E3 APO and stakeholders across the PDUs, combining business and technical aspects of the test environment.
 - Communicate, coordinate, and align scope, timelines, and risks with internal and external stakeholders.
 - Collaborate with other OPOs, APOs, and stakeholders to synchronize priorities and dependencies.
 - Support the APOs and TE architects in priority discussions and decisions.
 - Build a strong technical and business understanding so you can clearly explain the "what" and "why" to the teams.
 - Make sure the team understands its purpose and contribution, supporting engagement and motivation.
 - Ensure delivery meets high-quality standards and promote a product-level quality mindset within the team.
 - Identify improvement needs and propose efficient ways to strengthen the Packet Core test and lab strategy.
  
 The skills you bring:
 - Solid understanding of Agile methodologies, including Scrum and Kanban, and strong backlog handling.
 - Experience facilitating Agile team ceremonies.
 - Knowledge of software product management and a product-level quality mindset.
 - Experience with Confluence, Jira, or similar tools.
 - Basic business and customer understanding.
 - Strong decision-making, initiative, and relationship-building skills.
 - Strong analytical reasoning and problem-solving abilities, with a proactive attitude.
 - Delivering results and meeting customer expectations
 - Strong time management and organizational skills.
 - Ability to adapt to change and an open, innovative mindset.
 - Strong knowledge-sharing and collaboration skills.
 - Excellent written and verbal English communication.
Öppen för alla
Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

At Swedish Match – An affiliate of PMI, we are championing a smoke-free world from the Nordics across the globe.
 
Here, you get the best of both worlds: the entrepreneurial spirit of a Nordic company with more than 200 years of heritage, and the scale and career opportunities of a global leader. Join our 1,900 colleagues across the Nordics and help us deliver a smoke-free Nordics by 2035.
 
We are looking for a Supervisor IFMS Soft Services to oversee workplace services that support our employees and day-to-day operations. You will ensure services such as cleaning, reception, mailroom, catering, and visitor management are delivered safely, efficiently, and to a high standard. This is a big team with about 13 direct reports.
 
As a Supervisor, you will lead and support the team responsible for key workplace services, while collaborating with internal stakeholders and external service providers to ensure safe, efficient, and high-quality service delivery. 
 
What You'll Do 
Lead the day-to-day delivery of soft facilities services across the site. 
Manage external service providers and ensure contractual, quality, and operational requirements are met. 
Monitor service performance and customer satisfaction, identifying opportunities for improvement. 
Partner with internal stakeholders to understand workplace needs and resolve operational issues. 
Ensure compliance with health, safety, environmental, and workplace requirements. 
Support budgeting, cost control, risk management, and operational planning. 
Use service data and performance metrics to drive continuous improvement. 
Support workplace projects and coach team members and service partners to deliver high-quality services. 

 
Who You Are 
5+ years of proven leadership experience within facilities management, workplace services, hospitality, property management, or a related field. 
A relevant university degree, for example in facilities management, business administration, hospitality, property management, or a related area. 
Experienced in managing external vendors, contractors, and workplace services such as cleaning, catering, reception, or conference services. 
Strong communicator with the ability to build effective stakeholder relationships. 
Proactive, organized, and customer-focused, with solid knowledge of health and safety, compliance, and risk management. 
Comfortable using data and performance metrics to drive service improvements. 
Full professional proficiency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.

 
Benefits & Perks 
At Swedish Match, we want to support our employees through all stages of life. You will be covered by a collective bargaining agreement, occupational pension, and comprehensive healthcare insurance through Skandia.
 
We are especially proud of our family-friendly benefits. In addition to Swedish parental benefits, we supplement parental pay so that you can receive up to 100% of your salary during the first four months of parental leave. When returning to work, our First Month Back program gives you the opportunity to work 80% with full pay during your first month back.
 
You will also receive a wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year, 30 days of annual leave, a working time account (ATK), and additional time off in connection with public holidays and bridge days.

About the position
Mobility connects people. People shape mobility.
At Kongsberg Automotive, we develop and deliver world-class technology solutions for the global automotive industry. With innovation at our core and a global presence, we partner with the world’s leading automotive manufacturers to deliver safer, smarter, and more sustainable solutions — enabling the mobility of tomorrow.
We are looking for a Key Account Manager to strengthen our OEM sales activities. You will be responsible for managing and expanding business relationships with leading global automotive manufacturers. This position is based at our office in either Mullsjö or Mölndal.
The role reports to our Director Sales BU Actuation.
If you're comfortable in a fast-paced environment, hands-on, and eager to make a real impact, Kongsberg Automotive is the place for you.
Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business or a related field, with 3-5 years of experience in B2B Sales, preferably in the automotive industry
Proven track record in OEM account management, including closing deals and managing complex customer interfaces
Strong business acumen, structured analytical thinking with a fast-paced customer focused attitude
Ability to work independently while being a strong contributor to international, cross-functional teams
High proficiency in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
Fluent in English, both written and spoken
Valid class B driver’s license
Willing to travel up to 30% of the time

Responsibilities
Be the primary commercial interface between Kongsberg Automotive and key customer accounts by taking ownership of strategic business development and long-term relationship management
Drive sustainable profitable growth by identifying and developing new business opportunities with key customers 
Oversee all commercial aspects of the accounts, including strategy development, sales activities, forecasting, and reporting
Lead and coordinate initiatives with cross-functional teams (R&D, Operations, Finance and Purchasing) to deliver value driven customer results
Develop strong customer relationships with both existing and new customer accounts
Manage commercial activities including RFQs, commercial negotiations, price strategy, contractual agreements
Analyze market and technology trends, customer needs, competitor activity, and translate insights into the commercial strategy and product planning
Take responsibility for achieving account sales targets, new business development, sales budget & forecasting, and commercial excellence
Represent Kongsberg Automotive in internal and external forums, acting as the voice of the customer

What we offer
At Kongsberg Automotive, you will join an international industrial company where people and business performance go hand in hand. 
You will play an important role in developing our key customer relationships, driving business opportunities, and working closely with colleagues across our global organization.
We offer a supportive work environment, competitive benefits, an occupational pension, a wellness allowance, and additional benefits under the Swedish Engineering Industries Agreement (Teknikavtalet)
Application / Contact
If this sounds interesting and likely the right challenge for you, we look forward to receiving your application!
Please register your CV/resume and cover letter.
Within your application, please inform us regarding your notice period and salary expectations.
The applications will be handled on an ongoing basis and the position may be filled before the application deadline date.

Job Introduction
Be the driving force behind world-class warehouse automation solutions. As a Systems Technical Specialist, you will combine deep technical expertise with a passion for innovation to keep some of the most advanced automated warehouse systems performing at their best. Working closely with customers and internal experts, you will solve complex challenges, drive continuous improvements, and identify opportunities to enhance system performance, reliability, and efficiency.
More than just support, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our solutions. From advanced troubleshooting and SQL analysis to system optimisation, training, and customer engagement, your expertise will help transform great systems into exceptional ones. If you enjoy taking ownership, influencing technical direction, and delivering real value to customers in a fast-paced automation environment, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.
Main Responsibilities
You work with the Customer Support team to analyse incidents that may have been operator-related and look for trends or improvements
You engage with customers regarding system improvement opportunities and understand their actual goals
You maintain, review technical documentation and standardise where required
You support and develop training and training material for end users and internal colleagues
You lead and support the root cause analysis process when required
You monitor trends across multiple sites, investigate & propose system improvements
You support internal Lifetime Services projects and initiatives where required
You keep up to date with all new products that are related to warehouse control systems, proposing ideas on how to embed them with new customers and site support teams 
You support the sale and implementation of change requests, ensuring requirements are achieved and continuous improvement ideas are spread and known across the TGW portfolio
You have communication lines with all TGW departments applicable to the role and customers, and keep up to date with all releases to the warehouse controls systems within the TGW portfolio and understand improvements to the operation

About you
You have a BSc or Yrkeshögskola in Computer Science, IT Engineering or equivalent combination of education and proven commercial experience in a similar role
You have the ability to work on your own initiative and without supervision and experience dealing directly with customers/end users
You have experience with SQL Databases (Oracle, MySQL), database support or performance monitoring
You have materials handling / automation experience and experience in supporting the go-live phase of a project
You have experience in writing technical documents and demonstrate strong language proficiency in both written and spoken Swedish and English
You have experience with log file investigation and/or software debugging
You have an understanding of software development and the software development lifecycle

We offer
Permanent Contract with a competitive salary 
Company car
Life Assurance: 4 x Yearly Salary
Employee Assistance Programme
The amount of annual vacation is 25 working days and the Employee is entitled to a vacation pay of 0,8% of the monthly gross salary per vacation day
A dynamic, open and informal working environment with pleasant colleagues
Health care allowance and a free annual health check

jobs.occupation: AI & Regulatory Reporting Consultant for a Major Bank in Stockholm!
jobs.description:
Join our customer's innovative AI Programme and drive the future of Regulatory Reporting. This role offers the unique opportunity to implement cutting-edge GenAI and Snowflake solutions within a leading financial environment.
About the role
As an AI & Regulatory Reporting Consultant, you will bridge the gap between regulatory expertise and AI engineering. You will be hands-on, rapidly prototyping solutions and driving them toward production readiness to deliver measurable value to the organization.
You are offered
Opportunity to work on high-impact AI initiatives, utilize modern data platforms like Snowflake, and shape the future of intelligent regulatory reporting in a collaborative, forward-thinking environment.
Work tasks
In this role, you will accelerate the implementation of the AI programme, focusing on automated testing, control intelligence, and reporting analytics using GenAI and Snowflake. You will work closely with the AI Programme Lead, AI Champions, Regulatory Reporting SMEs and technology teams across three priority areas:
1) AI-enabled UAT and testing, including automated validation, reconciliation, and exception analysis.
2) Control Intelligence, supporting development of intelligent data-quality and control capabilities leveraging technologies available across the organization.
3) Reporting analytics and insights, including period-on-period analysis, anomaly identification, root-cause analysis and "talk to your data" capabilities.
Work tasks:
Translate business requirements into scalable, governed, and production-ready technical solutions.  
Develop AI-enabled UAT and testing solutions, including automated validation and reconciliation.  
Build Control Intelligence capabilities leveraging modern data technologies.  
Create reporting analytics and insights such as anomaly identification and 'talk to your data' features.  
Rapidly prototype AI solutions and mature them into sustainable, maintainable systems.  
Collaborate closely with AI Champions, SMEs, and technology teams across the organization.

We are looking for

At least 4 years of experience as a Data Analyst/AI Engineer, with the following skills and experience:

Strong experience with GenAI/AI technologies.

Strong experience in Snowflake, SQL and data analytics.

Hands-on experience developing AI agents, automated controls or intelligent analytics.

Strong focus on governance, traceability, maintainability, and production readiness.

Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into working technical solutions.

Comfortable working across business, data and technology teams.

Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

Swedish citizenship, citizenship of a Nordic or EU/EEA country, or alternatively a valid work permit in Sweden. This is required as the position starts in January 2027.

It is meritorious if you have
Prior experience within Banking, Finance, or Regulatory Reporting.
Relevant Azure, Snowflake, or AI certifications.

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
Trustful
Goal oriented
Stable
Responsible
Intellectually curious

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

Are you a Verification Engineer with experience in embedded systems and software validation? Do you enjoy working close to complex platform solutions, test automation, and system integration? Then this could be your next opportunity.
ALTEN is now looking for a Verification Engineer for an assignment towards one of our clients within the automotive industry. In this role, you will work with the verification of platform software running on ECUs and High-Performance Computers (HPC), ensuring quality, performance, and reliability throughout the development process.
About the role
As a Verification Engineer, you will be part of a platform team responsible for developing and integrating platform software consisting of AUTOSAR components, RTOS-based applications, and graphical applications running on Yocto and Qt/QML.
You will work closely with software developers, architects, suppliers, and project stakeholders to define verification strategies, execute testing activities, and secure delivery quality. The role combines test development, automation, troubleshooting, and system validation in both simulated and real-world environments.
Main responsibilities
Develop and execute verification plans for platform software components
Design, implement, and maintain automated test cases at unit and integration level
Define and execute verification strategies together with cross-functional teams
Perform root cause analysis of test failures and support issue resolution
Validate software using simulation tools, test rigs, and vehicle environments
Document test results and create verification reports
Ensure traceability between requirements and test activities
Contribute to continuous improvements of verification methods and processes
Collaborate closely with suppliers and internal development teams

Your profile
You are a structured and analytical engineer who enjoys solving technical challenges and working in a collaborative environment. You have a strong interest in embedded software, system validation, and test automation.
We see that you have:
B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or equivalent
Experience in software verification and validation within embedded systems
Experience with .NET / CANoe configuration
Knowledge of automotive communication protocols such as CAN, LIN, Ethernet, DoIP, SOME/IP, Stomp, or VLAN
Experience working with embedded Linux and RTOS environments
Experience working with automated testing frameworks and verification activities
Fluent in English, both written and spoken

Meritorious:
Experience with QNX OS and Hypervisor
Experience with AUTOSAR-based systems
Experience with Jenkins, SystemD, NetSim, or Google Test
Experience working with ECUs or High-Performance Computing (HPC) platforms

We warmly welcome your application!
About ALTEN
ALTEN is one of Europe’s largest engineering and IT consulting companies with over 57,000 employees in around 30 countries. Our engineers carry out advanced projects throughout the product development cycle for leading companies in sectors such as Automotive, Aerospace, Energy, and Life Sciences.
In Sweden, we are about 1,300 committed employees across 9 cities – from Lund in the south to Skellefteå in the north. For the sixth consecutive year, ALTEN has been recognized as one of Sweden’s most attractive employers by Karriärföretagen, thanks to our strong focus on career development, innovation, and engineering excellence.
Visit www.alten.se to learn more about us.

Job Description
Significant experience as a Senior Software Engineer, Software Architect, Technical Lead, or equivalent role in complex embedded software or automotive platform development.
Strong experience with embedded software architecture, complex ECU platforms, software integration, and cross-functional engineering environments.
Strong AUTOSAR competence, particularly AUTOSAR Classic Platform architecture and concepts, including software components, Basic Software (BSW), and the Runtime Environment (RTE).
Practical experience with AUTOSAR configuration, integration, troubleshooting, and interaction between application software and platform services is highly desirable.
Understanding of multi-ECU architectures and software-defined vehicle concepts, including interface management and platform-level dependencies.
Experience with architecture and design governance, technical decision-making, risk management, and systematic root-cause analysis.
Good understanding of automotive software development processes, engineering quality practices, continuous integration, and delivery toolchains.
Working knowledge of C/C++; scripting experience with Python, Bash, or similar languages is beneficial.
Experience working with distributed, cross-functional teams and coordinating technical topics across organizational boundaries.
Strong communication, facilitation, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics clearly.
Fluent English, both written and spoken.

 
Relevant Tools and Technologies
Software and scripting: C/C++, Python, Bash, YAML.
Version control and code review: Git, Gerrit.
CI/CD and automation: Jenkins, GitLab CI, Zuul, Cynosure, Ansible.
Verification and integration: CANoe and related integration/debugging tools.
Build and deployment ecosystem: Artifactory, Docker.
Monitoring and reporting: Grafana, VictoriaMetrics, and related dashboards.
Collaboration and lifecycle tools: Jira, Confluence, and applicable requirements/engineering tools.
Engineering frameworks and processes: applicable platform development, engineering, and quality standards.

Job Responsibilities
Provide technical leadership and day-to-day technical coordination across platform workstreams.
Maintain architectural alignment and consistency across software components, interfaces, integrations, and releases.
Contribute to platform architecture, design reviews, technical roadmaps, and engineering standards; document recommendations and decisions.
Provide technical guidance on embedded software, ECU/platform integration, software component design, and system-level dependencies.
Apply AUTOSAR architectural principles and support alignment between software architecture, platform configuration, and integration needs.
Coordinate technical dependencies and interfaces between development, integration, verification, quality, and other relevant engineering teams.
Identify, assess, and manage technical risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies; escalate critical topics with clear impact analysis and proposed options.
Lead or coordinate technical investigations, root-cause analysis, and resolution of complex platform issues.
Promote software quality, maintainability, reuse, robustness, and integration efficiency throughout the development lifecycle.
Support integration planning, technical readiness reviews, release preparation, and resolution of issues affecting delivery milestones.
Encourage continuous improvement in engineering practices, automation, development workflows, and technical governance.
Ensure technical documentation is accurate, accessible, and maintained, and support knowledge transfer across teams.
Provide clear technical status, risks, decisions, and recommendations to program and engineering stakeholders.

 
Department/Project Description
The Platform Technical Lead is responsible for overall technical coordination, architectural alignment, and technical quality across platform maintenance and development activities. The role ensures that technical decisions, designs, interfaces, and implementation approaches remain consistent with agreed platform architecture, engineering standards, and delivery objectives. The Technical Lead works closely with platform stakeholders and cross-functional engineering teams, provides technical direction, and supports the progressive transfer of platform knowledge and ownership.

Mission
Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.
In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.
Role Purpose
As a Doctor at Neko Health, you're shaping the future of healthcare. You'll be at the cutting edge of preventive healthcare and lifestyle medicine, harnessing state-of-the-art diagnostic tools to unveil health risks and steer patients towards healthier lives. Your mission will be to guide patients towards a path of better health, informed by the latest advancements in both dermatological and cardiovascular preventive care. Utilising our high-resolution skin scanning and AI technology, you'll play a key role in early detection and management of skin conditions. Leveraging your expertise to educate patients about their cardiovascular risks, you will foster a proactive approach to heart health. Surrounded by a clinical team who's passionate about preventive healthcare and functional medicine, you'll join a ground-breaking organisation that values excellence, promotes work-life balance, and offers professional growth opportunities in the realms of dermatology, preventative healthcare, health technology and AI.
We are looking for doctors who can work from 17 hours per week up to full-time in shifts. Available shifts: daytime, evenings, and Saturdays. The role requires a minimum commitment of one evening shift per week and one Saturday shift per month. The remaining shifts are as agreed.
What You'll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months
Conduct thorough health screenings and assessments.
Translate complex diagnostic results into actionable insights.
Craft personalised plans for lifestyle change to improve health outcomes.
Offer holistic advice on a spectrum of health conditions.
Liaise with our members' doctors for seamless patient care coordination.
Collaborate with our multidisciplinary team to coordinate and improve patient care.
Stay abreast of the latest developments in medical diagnostics and preventive health.
Champion patient education, inspiring proactive health management.
Contribute to clinical quality improvement activity.
Participate in our research programs.
Collaborate with teams across Neko to develop and improve our technology.

Minimum Qualifications
You are a registered doctor.

You enjoy a fast pace, are confident in your role, and challenges excite you.
You are compelled to deliver high-quality results in everything you do.
You are curious and dedicated to continuous learning.
You have a solution-oriented mindset.
You speak fluent in both Swedish and English.

We offer a dynamic work environment with a high degree of autonomy that fosters growth and development. If you are passionate about building a better healthcare system for everyone and you thrive in a fast-paced environment, we would love to hear from you.
Interviews are ongoing, so don't hesitate to send in your application today!

At the Vitrolife Group, we work every day to unlock the full potential of science and technology to reduce the barriers towards building a family. Together we help our customers and their patients to fulfill the dream of having a baby.

 To be successful in this position you would need:

We are currently approximately 1 100 colleagues worldwide, with headquarters in Gothenburg, Sweden. At Tata Technologies, we make product development dreams a reality by designing, engineering, and validating the products of tomorrow for the world’s leading manufacturers. Due to our continued growth, we are now recruiting an Electrical Design Engineer to strengthen our engineering team.
Scope of Role
As an Electrical Design Engineer, you will be responsible for maintaining, updating, and validating electrical design documentation and calculations across multiple engineering platforms. The role ensures accuracy, consistency, and compliance with engineering standards across schematics, layouts, part lists, and system calculations. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to support electrical design integrity and system performance.
Main Responsibilities
Update and maintain electrical schematics and layouts, ensuring accurate location coding (EPLAN, AutoCAD).
Develop and modify electrical drawings according to project specifications.
Manage and validate electrical part lists, ensuring consistency and completeness of BOMs.
Extract and verify data generated from EPLAN outputs.
Perform and validate cable sizing and related calculations (El-vis tool).
Support energy consumption calculations and related documentation.
Maintain and update IP addressing within electrical documentation.
Perform and validate Performance Level (PL) calculations in line with safety standards (Sistema).
Develop and maintain electrical topology diagrams (Visio).
Ensure consistency of location codes across all tools and documentation platforms.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment with system architecture and engineering requirements.

Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Electrical Engineering or equivalent.
4 to 6 years of experience in electrical design engineering.
Strong knowledge of electrical system design, industrial automation, and control panel engineering.
Experience in developing and maintaining electrical schematics, layouts, and topology documentation.
Good understanding of electrical safety standards, Performance Level (PL), and risk reduction principles.
Experience working in industrial, manufacturing, or automotive environments.
Ability to work independently and collaborate within cross-functional teams.

Tools & Skills
EPLAN – electrical schematics and part list generation
AutoCAD – electrical layouts
El-vis – cable calculations
Sistema – performance level calculations
Visio – topology documentation
Strong knowledge of location code management and data consistency across tools
Experience working with global teams and customer-specific standards
Proficiency in English, both written and spoken

Personal Qualities
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Detail-oriented with a structured approach to work
Effective communication and collaboration skills
Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced environment
Proactive and self-driven mindset
Comfortable working in cross-functional and international teams

Operating and monitoring automated and semi-automated production equipment

Setting up and running production machinery according to established procedures

Monitoring machine performance and identifying deviations

Performing basic troubleshooting and assisting with machine-related issues

Carrying out quality checks and documenting production results

Following work instructions, procedures and safety routines

Collaborating with colleagues to ensure an efficient production flow

Supporting continuous improvements within the production team

The role requires you to work both independently and as part of a team while taking ownership of your responsibilities following your training period.

What we're looking for
Experience working as a machine operator, production operator or in another manufacturing environment

A genuine interest in machinery, technology and manufacturing processes

The ability to understand and follow technical instructions, documentation and work procedures

Strong problem-solving skills and a structured, logical approach to troubleshooting

jobs.occupation: Business Development & Executive Search Consultant – Defence & Security
jobs.description:
Arbetsbeskrivning

JOB DESCRIPTION

Would you like to help build a growing executive search and specialist recruitment business in the Nordic defence and security sector?

In this role, you will develop client relationships, identify new business opportunities and lead recruitment assignments for organisations operating in a fast-growing and highly competitive industry. You will work closely with both clients and candidates, building a strong understanding of their needs and the people who can help move their organisations forward.

You will take ownership of your market and have the opportunity to shape your own position. This means staying close to the industry, learning continuously and taking an active role in conversations with companies and candidates across the Nordics and internationally.

The role combines business development with the delivery of high-quality search assignments. 

Din Profil

PROFILE

You are curious about the defence and security sector and genuinely motivated to understand the industry, its organisations and the people who work in it. Previous experience from the defence industry is not essential. What matters is that you are keen to learn, read up on the sector and enjoy building relationships with people who work in complex and important fields.

You are confident in client-facing situations and able to earn trust in a demanding environment. You take responsibility, put the client first and understand the importance of careful, professional relationship management with both clients and candidates. You are comfortable working internationally and collaborating across cultures.

We believe you will bring:

- Experience in a commercial, consulting, recruitment or other client-facing role
- Strong relationship-building and communication skills
- A genuine interest in people and in developing a deep understanding of the industries you serve
- A proactive, accountable and curious approach to your work
- The ability to communicate fluently in Swedish and English
- A valid B-category driving licence

We value sound judgement, maturity and personal drive. Your ability to build confidence, follow through and represent the business with professionalism matters as much as your years of experience.

Om företaget

ABOUT US

Defence Executive is being built as a Nordic executive search and specialist recruitment business focused on the defence and security sector. We are part of an established recruitment team with experience across several specialist industries, and we work closely together while each person develops their own market.

Our team has worked with some of the largest international defence groups, and we are a strategic partner. Joining us means helping to develop a growing Nordic platform with an established team and a recognised foundation in specialist recruitment. You will have room to be creative, build your own position and help shape how we work in the industry.

We are based in attractive offices on Drottninggatan in central Stockholm.

Kontaktuppgifter

CONTACT

Interested in helping build the next chapter of Defence Executive? Please submit your application and CV through the application form.

We look forward to hearing from people who are curious about the industry, passionate about building relationships and motivated to create long-term value for clients and candidates.
